Name: Aquazone: Life Simulator
Overview:
AquaZone: Life Simulator is a simple simulation game where players build a fish tank, fill it with fish and then having to care for the fish.

The game becomes gradually more difficult when more types of fish get added, which all require different care. New and better aquariums are unlocked by progressing through the game and successfully caring for fish. If the player cares successfully for the fish, they might lay eggs. This unlocks new objects that can be placed in the aquariums.

The player can unlock and choose from 22 different species of fish. 18 extra fish were available through separate dlc's, able to be bought with Microsoft Points.
